title: Gotalk index protocol v1: shared definitions

id.description: An opaque ID, stable for the life of the object. Gotalk servers use UUIDs, but consumers must not parse IDs.

timestamp.description: An RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC, for example 2026-10-18T09:24:15Z. Fractional seconds are allowed.

cursor.description: An opaque pagination or feed cursor. Pass it back unchanged as the cursor parameter.

author.description: A post or topic author. Only these three fields: content never carries email addresses, IP addresses or avatar URLs.

problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem details body. Gotalk sets type to https://gotalk.sh/problems/{code} and repeats the code.

originUrl.description: An instance origin: scheme, host and optional port, no path.

instanceStatus.description: An instance's status in the index.
